first_stage.question: Effect of the two evidence-backed room floor corrections on fixed-input-family policy comparisons
first_stage.baseline: 90 original-registry mixed rows from motion_repair_v1 and motion_repair_extra_seeds_v1
first_stage.comparison: Date/seed pairing; classroom additions alter generated demand and transfers, so compare policy contrasts rather than asserting individual-passenger causal pairing.

second_stage.question: Fixed-rule robustness across early, middle and late ordinary teaching weeks
second_stage.selection: Early/middle/late coverage after add/drop, avoiding general reading week, weekday public holidays and previously simulated weeks. No policy outcomes inspected for these dates.
second_stage.scope: September-2 schedule snapshot with October-31 headcount assumptions; programme calendar and actual attendance are not reconstructed.
